summary_markdown: The participants discussed the need to clean up a PostgreSQL database. Following the cleanup, [me] requested that an alert percentage be set at 10% or 15%. [p1] noted that setting this would apply across all hosts. To address this, [p1] offered to temporarily disable (for one week) the specific alert on a single host instead of all hosts.
decisions: The PostgreSQL database will be cleaned up.
The alert will be disabled for one week on a single host.
action_items: [p1] to disable the specified alert on one host for one week.
